market_view: Calm regime: VIX 15.8 and falling, dollar firm near its 252-day high, 10-year yield 4.54%. Crude gave back part of its Iran-driven bounce on 07-09 (WTI -2.0%) but is still up 5% over five days; the Fed flags stepped-up inflation from tariffs, the Iran war and the AI buildout.

oil_gas.catalyst: Continuing hold of the 07-07 supply-shock long (Iran waiver revoked, Hormuz tanker attacks, blockade threat); this record has only 'Strait of Hormuz: What has happened since the US-Iran MoU on June 17?' (Al Jazeera), which shows no clear de-escalation.
oil_gas.reasoning: No exit signal: no de-escalation or waiver reinstatement headline, and the 10-day horizon runs to about 07-21. WTI still +5% over 5 days; 07-09 pullback (XOM -2.6%) trims conviction to the threshold. Q2 earnings in late July add variance.

gold_miners.catalyst: none; 'Newmont: Buy The Dip' (Seeking Alpha) is an opinion piece, not a catalyst
gold_miners.reasoning: Gold +1.4% on 07-09 is already priced; gold is 22% off its high with a firm dollar and sticky yields. No NEM-specific news; Q2 call and jobs data add variance only.

chips.catalyst: none; 'Micron Accelerates U.S. Investments, Pours First Concrete at New York Fab' (Micron IR) is capex news that does not reach NVDA
chips.reasoning: No NVDA-specific headline; sector ETF +2.5% yesterday is priced in. Earnings season and TSMC sales add variance, not direction.

pharma.catalyst: none; FDA headlines (manufacturing framework, PFAS, an eye-drop recall) do not touch LLY
pharma.reasoning: LLY sits 1.5% below its high after a 31% 60-day run with no trial, approval or pricing news in the record.

copper_uranium.catalyst: none for FCX; 'Australia, India strike deal on uranium exports during Modi visit' (Reuters) and the uranium-mining growth story bear on uranium names, not the leader FCX
copper_uranium.reasoning: Copper +2.7% and FCX +5.3% on 07-09 already happened; no copper supply or China demand headline to expect continuation.

would_change_my_mind: A US-Iran de-escalation or reinstated sanctions waiver (exit XOM), or a named NEM, NVDA, LLY or FCX catalyst such as guidance, approval or a copper supply outage.

handoff.what_changed: Crude kept most of its Iran bounce (WTI +5.1% over 5 days) but fell 2% on 07-09 and XOM fell 2.6%; no headline shows a blockade, strikes or de-escalation. A Fed report cites stepped-up inflation from tariffs, the Iran war and AI spending. Australia and India agreed a uranium export deal; no family has a new catalyst, so XOM is kept and the rest stay flat.

oil_gas.why: Iran/Hormuz supply-shock catalyst not reversed; confidence trimmed to 0.52 after the 07-09 crude pullback.

gold_miners.why: Gold bear market with a firm dollar; only opinion pieces on NEM.

chips.why: No NVDA-specific catalyst; Micron fab news does not reach NVDA.

pharma.why: LLY near highs with no trial, approval or pricing news.

copper_uranium.why: Uranium deal news bears on CCJ, not leader FCX; copper bounce priced in.
